title: Cardio and Abdominals
author: Michael_Hook_760923
desc: The purpose of Built for Battle: Cardio and Core Domination is to forge operational-level conditioning through structured cardiovascular training and core development. This 12-week program is designed to build endurance, power, and resilience under pressure, enhancing the body’s ability to perform, recover, and sustain through demanding physical and mental challenges. Participants will cultivate a battle-ready engine and a fortified core capable of driving peak performance in any environment.

ex.note:
Intensity: 60–70% max HR (conversational pace)

Options: Incline walk, cycle, row, ruck, or jog
Hang from a pull-up bar; raise knees to chest under control, avoid swinging.
Perform on a decline bench, engaging abs through full range.
Maintain tight core; extend arms forward until stretch in abs, then return.
Engage quads, glutes, and abs; pull elbows and toes toward each other.

Intensity: 60–70% max HR (conversational pace)

Options: Incline walk, cycle, row, ruck, or jog
Pivot through hips and pull handle diagonally across the body.
Lower hip toward floor, then raise, maintaining straight alignment.
Sit at 45°, rotate torso side to side while holding a plate or med ball.
Press cable/band forward at chest height resisting rotation.

Intensity: 60–70% max HR (conversational pace)

Options: Incline walk, cycle, row, ruck, or jog
Extend opposite arm and leg, pause, then return maintaining balance.
Keep spine neutral; hinge at hips and extend fully.
Lie supine, lift hips to roll spine off ground.

Walk slowly while bracing core; do not let torso lean.

Distance: 30-40m per side.

Intensity: 60–70% max HR (conversational pace)

Options: Incline walk, cycle, row, ruck, or jog
Drive knees to chest rapidly while maintaining flat back.
Hinge at the hips with a kettlebell in both hands.
Lift legs straight to hip or bar level; control descent.
Reach opposite arm to foot; engage abs fully at the top.
